title: Add a job by URL (POST /ingest-url body)
description: Sent by the dashboard's Add URL flow to the Browser Use worker, authenticated with x-discovery-secret. The worker proves a Sheets credential before any extraction and answers 409 `sheets_credential_missing` without one.

url.description: The posting URL. Local and private-network URLs are refused.

sheetId.description: Target Sheet. Optional when the worker config holds a default sheetId.

async.description: When true the worker answers 202 accepted_async with a statusPath (run-status.v1) and extracts in the background.

googleAccessToken.description: Optional short-lived dashboard Google token for this request only; never persisted or logged.

manual.description: Manual fill: skip extraction and write these fields.
